programme.title: Saschiz Old Town, Romania
programme.desc: Saschiz, village, and commune, Mureș județ county is located in central Romania. The villages of Saschiz, Mihai Viteazu, and Cloașterf make up the larger commune of Saschiz. Located in the old region of Transylvania, it lies about 20 km east of Sighișoara"&". First documented in the 14th century, Saschiz is known for its medieval fortress and church constructed by Transylvanian Saxons, a German speaker. They settled in Transylvania when it was part of Hungary. The ruins of the 14th-century fortress sit atop "&"a hill overlooking the village. The late 15th-century fortified church has Gothic details and an imposing clock tower. Along with five other villages with fortified churches, Saschiz was inscribed on UNESCO’s World Heritage sites in 1999.

programme.desc: Molly Moo-Cow and The Butterflies

programme.desc: Foghorn convinces Henery that Sylvester is a chicken. Foghorn sticks Henery in an egg and sticks it under Sylvester.

programme.title: Felix the Ghost Breaker-1923
programme.desc: Felix is trying to get some sleep in a graveyard, but keeps getting bothered by a ghost. He follows the ghost to the house of an old farmer, and the ghost proceeds to terrorize the old man, and when the farmer calls for help from the police, the ghost terrorizes them, too. Felix, however, suspects something fishy is going on, and with the help of the farmer's donkey, gets to the bottom of things.

programme.title: Me Feelins is Hurt 1940
programme.desc: Olive writes a letter to Popeye: she's through with sailors; it's cowboys for her. Popeye immediately sails off to the West, where he finds, who else, Bluto as the head of the ranch where Olive is enthralled. Bluto gives Popeye a wild horse to ride, and, after a few humiliating defeats, Popeye conquers it (and wins back Olive's heart). Bluto punches Popeye out, and into the clutches of what can best be described as a rattlesnake constrictor. Bluto then starts menacing Olive, so Popeye eats his spinach, saves her, and defeats Bluto and his gang.

programme.title: Leprechauns Gold 1949
programme.desc: A song-filled Noveltoon featuring the antics of the Irish Leprechauns during their annual gold-washing ceremony. It depicts the wee people of Ireland who flavor its traditions with laughs and legend.

programme.title: Cookin' with Gags 1955
programme.desc: The boys are taking Olive on a picnic. It's April 1, and Bluto plays a series of "jokes" on Popeye, though of course they go beyond the bounds of acceptability, particularly once they get to the picnic grounds; Bluto puts gasoline on the fire he asks Popeye to light and swaps a beehive for the lemonade. Bluto then launches a cruel joke against Olive and frames Popeye. The capper: he replaces Popeye's spinach with a joke can, and runs off with Olive for some canoeing. But Popeye gets the last laugh with an inflatable sea monster.

programme.title: Quack a Doodle Doo 1950
programme.desc: His Mama is the only one who love Baby Huey, an overgrown clumsy ugly duckling. The other Mamas and their broods shun him like the plague and make his little life miserable. But when a ferocious fox attacks the barnyard, Huey comes to the rescue of one and all. Huey is a hero basking in his new-found popularity. First of the series.

programme.title: Trolley Ahoy-1936

programme.title: Taxi Turvy 1945

programme.title: The Star of Bethlehem956

programme.title: Noah's Ark 1959
programme.desc: Noah gets the word: build an ark in seven days. His sons cut the necessary trees in three days, and much furious sawing and hammering follows. But there's no rest, as they need to round up all the animals. Noah boards the animals, then his sons, their wives, and his wife (who packed a ferocious picnic). The rains and flood begin. The animals soon develop cabin fever and get restless, but Mrs. Noah has the answer: "Music has charms to soothe the savage beast." His sons find instruments and begin playing; everyone dances. But Harry the hippo dances with everyone but his wife; Noah goes to her, and while she tells him not to mention Harry's name, Noah convinces her that Harry is thinking only of her. The rains end; Noah sends a dove out who brings back an olive branch. They land on Mount Ararat and disembark.

In the midst of fighting dozens of bulls, they receive a telegram that Prohibition has been repealed back in the U.S. They immediately leave Spain headed back to the U.S. for a drink

programme.title: Aladdin(Mel-O-Toons) 1960
programme.desc: In this adaptation of the Arabian Nights tale, poor Aladdin discovers a magic lamp containing a genie who grants his wish to marry a princess.

programme.title: Private Snafu; Volume 1-1943
programme.desc: Introducing Private Snafu, the nation's worst soldier and his various versions in different branches of the armed forces

programme.title: Private Snafu; Volume 1-1943

programme.title: Felix in the Bone Age-1922
programme.desc: Felix comes upon a caveman and his girlfriend. The girlfriend is crying, and when the caveman asks her what she wants, she points to Felix. The caveman chases Felix, who escapes by using the tails of some friendly monkeys to make his way down a steep cliff. Later he makes friends with a baby monkey, but winds up getting in a fight with a huge gorilla.

programme.title: Betty Boop- Baby Be Good-1935
programme.desc: Betty Boop tells naughty Little Jimmy a corrective fairy tale (with herself as fairy). Part of the action is replayed in reverse.

programme.title: The Underground World-1943
programme.desc: Lois Lane and an explorer set out on an expedition through an underground cavern and discover a race of hawk-men. When these creatures prepare a ritual sacrifice for the adventurous pair, Superman comes to the rescue.

programme.title: Spooky Swabs 1957
programme.desc: Popeye and Olive are shipwrecked; they think they are saved when they see a ship, but what they don't realize is that the crew of the Sea Witch is all ghosts, and soon they are under attack, but they don't know from what for a while

programme.title: Out to Punch 1956
programme.desc: Popeye's training for his boxing match with Bluto by jumping rope with a massive chain. Bluto, who's lazy about everything except sabotage, decides he needs to stop Popeye. He fills Popeye's heavy bag with iron junk, but Popeye punches it over the fence onto Bluto. Next, he pulls on the springs attached to the wall with a motorcycle, but Popeye pulls so hard he throws Bluto and the cycle through the building and into a well. Popeye is walking -- or actually, prancing -- behind Olive on the way to the match, so Bluto tries a bit more sabotage: first an oil slick, which slows Popeye down briefly, then some quick-dry cement in a puddle. This gives Popeye cement overshoes, and when he gets to the arena, he's exhausted. Olive stands him up, but Bluto treats him like a punching bag. He's got Popeye on the floor (under the ring), so Olive finally breaks out the spinach. Popeye knocks Bluto through the roof, right into the hospital. The photographers ask for a picture, and Popeye's biceps form the words

programme.title: Popeye Meets Sinbad the Sailor 1936
programme.desc: The legendary sailors Popeye and Sindbad do battle to see which one is the greatest.

programme.title: Superman cartoons 3
programme.desc: Superman cartoons 3

programme.title: I Don't Scare 1956
programme.desc: Popeye has beaten Bluto to a date with Olive. Seeing that Olive is superstitious, Bluto changes the date to Friday the 13th, and proceeds to rig various proofs that bad things will happen if she goes out.

programme.title: The Trojan Horse 1960
programme.desc: During the Trojan War, the Greeks build a giant wooden horse as a stratagem to conquer the city of Troy. Adapted from the Greek myth.

programme.title: Superman: Eleventh Hour- 1942
programme.desc: While Clark Kent is in wartime Japan, Superman becomes a saboteur.

programme.title: popeye meets ali baba's forty thieves (1080)
programme.desc: Popeye the Sailor, accompanied by Olive Oyl and Wimpy, is dispatched to stop the dreaded bandit Abu Hassan and his force of forty thieves

programme.title: Molly Moo-Cow and The Butterflies -1935
programme.desc: Molly Moo-Cow and The Butterflies

programme.title: Cookin' with Gags 1955
programme.desc: The boys are taking Olive on a picnic. It's April 1, and Bluto plays a series of "jokes" on Popeye, though of course they go beyond the bounds of acceptability, particularly once they get to the picnic grounds; Bluto puts gasoline on the fire he asks Popeye to light and swaps a beehive for the lemonade. Bluto then launches a cruel joke against Olive and frames Popeye. The capper: he replaces Popeye's spinach with a joke can, and runs off with Olive for some canoeing. But Popeye gets the last laugh with an inflatable sea monster.

programme.title: Bride and Gloom
programme.desc: Popeye is marrying Olive tomorrow; he's ecstatic. She has a dream of the future, including twin sons who prove to be a real handful. When Popeye comes by the next morning, he gets a frosty reception

programme.title: Plane Dumb-1932
programme.desc: After crash landing in Africa, Tom and Jerry masquerade as Africans in a futile attempt to adapt to a strange environment.

programme.title: Balloon Land-1935
programme.desc: The inhabitants, including the trees and rocks, of Balloon Land are made entirely of balloons. They come under attack from the evil Pincushion Man. With the help of a quickly inflated army, they manage to fend off the attack.

programme.title: to duck or not to duck
programme.desc: While Elmer Fudd is hunting fowl, he shoots Daffy Duck. However, Daffy is wearing a bullet-proof vest and only pretends to be wounded

programme.title: Private eye popeye (1080)
programme.desc: Private Eye Popeye gets a call from Olive Oyl to guard a precious gem. But no sooner does he get the gem than the butler takes it (and Olive). The rest of the cartoon is spent chasing the crook to Paris, the Swiss Alps, and North Africa; Popeye always gets there first, but fails to make the arrest until he lucks into some spinach, of course

programme.title: Space Thunder Kids 1991
programme.desc: Three children pilots fight against the Dark Empire on their mission to destroy the universe.

programme.title: A Haunting we Will Go 1949
programme.desc: Casper the Friendly Ghost, sad that he can make no friends since everyone he meets is afraid of him, hatches an abandoned egg and becomes the emerging little duck's best friend and protector.

programme.title: Betty Boop- The Scared Crows 1939
programme.desc: Betty Boop and Pudgy, doing the spring planting, are plagued by crows.

programme.title: Now Hear This 1962
programme.desc: In this very abstract cartoon, a hard-of-hearing old Britisher finds a red horn and uses it as a megaphone, unaware that it is really a lost horn from the Devil's forehead. The Britisher finds that the horn has the effect of amplifying every sound psychedelically and causing him serious bodily harm

programme.title: Tulips Shall Grow 1942
programme.desc: A carefree boy and a young girl find their idyllic countryside invaded by an army of mindlessly destructive robots.

programme.title: The Crystal Brawl 1957
programme.desc: Bluto muscles out Popeye to take Olive to the fair. Popeye rushes ahead and poses as a fortune teller, luring Olive in. He shows Olive her future (actually, her past) in the crystal ball: first, a clip of a mountain climbing sequence that culminates in Bluto assaulting Olive. Then, a clip from another amusement park showing strongman Bluto stealing Olive away to a roller-coaster while Popeye rings a strength-testing bell repeatedly. Olive, having seen this, no longer wants anything to do with Bluto and walks out. Bluto exposes Popeye and chases Olive into a Tunnel of Love; Popeye follows and trashes Bluto.

programme.title: Superman: The Magnetic Telescope- 1942
programme.desc: When police interfere with a reckless scientist's experiment, it creates a deadly meteor shower only Superman can stop.

programme.title: Sintel -2010
programme.desc: In this epic fantasy tale, Sintel - a young lonely girl - finds companion in a wounded baby dragon, in the streets of a city in decay

programme.title: From plush toys to holograms: The growing world of AI companionship
programme.desc: Artificial intelligence is evolving—from answering our questions to keeping us company. From robotic pets in our neighborhoods to holographic characters that sense our mood, AI companionship is stepping out of science fiction and into everyday life. What does this mean for human relationships and the future of connection itself? Reporter Zhang Hong explores the rise of these new companions.

programme.title: A Village Homestay in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, our presenter Tianran He’s heading out of Beijing proper, to the city’s Miyun District. There he’ll meet some people running guesthouses who gave up their day jobs, in order to achieve the dream of a place of their own in the country.

programme.title: Young Chinese dare to express their culture
programme.desc: A fresh chapter in cultural storytelling is being written by young Chinese around the world. Young Chinese are amplifying tradition through trend, donning hanfu not only in historical lanes but in everyday life, and weaving those visuals into the fabric of social media. Our reporter Ioana Gomoi meets the creators who are turning heritage into a trendy cultural inspiration.

programme.title: An Echo of Antiquity: The Enduring Charm of Kunqu
programme.desc: Kunqu Opera, the "ancestor of a hundred operas," condenses its 600-year essence. From its melodious and captivating vocals to its elegant and delicate movements, we will explore the unique charm of this ancient performing art and the profound cultural heritage behind it.

programme.title: From bean to cup: The rise of China’s specialty coffee
programme.desc: Pu’er — a city named after tea — is now at the center of another brewing story: China’s fast-rising coffee industry. From mountain farms to urban cafés, a new generation of growers and coffee professionals is bringing China’s specialty coffee onto the global stage. What makes Yunnan’s coffee region unique? How are farmers, industry professionals, and consumers shaping a new coffee ecosystem in China? Join us as we explore how China’s coffee culture is evolving — from origin to cup.

programme.title: LIVING THE NEW WAVE China's livestream shopping boom redefines e-commerce
programme.desc: Now, we’re taking you inside one of China’s most dynamic phenomena—the livestream shopping revolution. From the misty tea mountains of Guizhou to Beijing’s glittering jewelry studios, millions tune in daily not just to purchase, but to connect. How did this fusion of entertainment and e-commerce become such a powerful cultural force? And what does it tell us about the future of shopping worldwide? Our reporter Lucy Lyv is here with us.

programme.title: A Vibe of the Village: The Beat of Xiangxi Drums
programme.desc: Experience the vibrant power of Xiangxi Drum Dance. This program delves into the heart of Tujia and Miao cultures, showcasing the rhythmic beats and spirited performances that have echoed through West Hunan's mountains for centuries. Discover the stories, traditions, and raw energy of this captivating folk art.

programme.title: INVESTING IN JOY: Inside China's new emotional economy
programme.desc: Today's young Chinese generation are driving a new "emotional economy," spending not just on necessities but on feelings. programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: The Inner Horizon: China's extreme sports revolution
programme.desc: They say in China, the most exciting frontiers aren't always on a map. A new cultural wave is sweeping the nation, turning vertical rock faces, open skies, and dense forests into new playgrounds. I recently ventured out to explore why extreme sports are becoming the new national pastime, and what this reveals about the changing spirit of China.

programme.title: Wudang Martial Arts and Taichi
programme.desc: Join host Yegor on a journey into the heart of China’s Wudang Mountains—the spiritual cradle of Taoism and the birthplace of Wudang martial arts. Through in-depth conversations with renowned masters such as Zhong Xueyong, Cai Chongguang, Jake Pinnick, and Liu Xiang, this episode explores the philosophy, techniques, and living spirit of Wudang Quan and Taichi. From the internal cultivation of qi to the harmony between body and mind, Wudang martial arts are more than just physical training—they are a way of life rooted in the Tao. Alongside martial techniques, the program also delves into traditional Chinese music, calligraphy, and medicine, revealing how these disciplines come together in the pursuit of balance, self-awareness, and longevity. This is not just a story of punches and postures, but of tradition, transformation, and the timeless search for harmony between humans and the universe.

programme.title: The beat of the city: Inside China's booming Livehouse scene

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the "Xiangjiang Ladies" who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: Young Chinese dare to express their culture
programme.desc: A fresh chapter in cultural storytelling is being written by young Chinese around the world. Young Chinese are amplifying tradition through trend, donning hanfu not only in historical lanes but in everyday life, and weaving those visuals into the fabric of social media. Our reporter Ioana Gomoi meets the creators who are turning heritage into a trendy cultural inspiration.

programme.title: Indigo Dreams: A Hue of Dali Tie-dye
programme.desc: Dali Tie-dye is the unique textile art of the Bai people, renowned for its exquisite hand-tying and traditional indigo dyeing techniques that create brilliant, one-of-a-kind patterns. Explore the cultural heritage and enduring beauty of this ancient craft from Yunnan.

programme.title: LIVING THE NEW WAVE China's livestream shopping boom redefines e-commerce
programme.desc: Now, we’re taking you inside one of China’s most dynamic phenomena—the livestream shopping revolution. From the misty tea mountains of Guizhou to Beijing’s glittering jewelry studios, millions tune in daily not just to purchase, but to connect. How did this fusion of entertainment and e-commerce become such a powerful cultural force? And what does it tell us about the future of shopping worldwide? Our reporter Lucy Lyv is here with us.

programme.title: Awakening Lion-1
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: INVESTING IN JOY: Inside China's new emotional economy
programme.desc: Today's young Chinese generation are driving a new "emotional economy," spending not just on necessities but on feelings. From trendy toys that offer joy and community, to serene scents that provide a moment of peace – they are investing in personal well-being, reshaping the consumer landscape.

programme.title: Rhythms of the Forest: A Sound of Li Instruments
programme.desc: Li bamboo and wood instruments offer a journey into the unique sounds of Hainan's Li ethnic group. Explore the ancient craftsmanship and musical heritage, from the resonant tones of bamboo flutes to the percussive rhythms of wooden drums. Experience the natural melodies that tell the stories of the Li people.

programme.title: The Inner Horizon: China's extreme sports revolution
programme.desc: They say in China, the most exciting frontiers aren't always on a map. A new cultural wave is sweeping the nation, turning vertical rock faces, open skies, and dense forests into new playgrounds. What was once the domain of a handful of adventurers is now a booming lifestyle for millions of young Chinese. I recently ventured out to explore why extreme sports are becoming the new national pastime, and what this reveals about the changing spirit of China.

programme.title: Forged in Legend: A Glimpse of Longquan Blades
programme.desc: Longquan swords, legendary blades from China, embody centuries of masterful craftsmanship. Forged with unique folding techniques and a distinctive star-patterned finish, these swords are renowned for their sharpness, resilience, and artistic value. Discover the rich history and cultural significance of these revered symbols of Chinese heritage.

programme.title: The beat of the city: Inside China's booming Livehouse scene
programme.desc: From the intimate jazz vibes of Beijing's Blue Note to the electric energy of a Guangzhou livehouse — we dive into China's booming nightlife scene. Discover how these venues are more than just places for a night out — they're cultural hubs where young audiences connect, artists innovate, and the city's heart beats to a brand new rhythm.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Infra-red cameras in the dead of night reveals a forest pit-viper sense and strike a target just fractionally warmer than its surroundings. Then there's the mussurana - a snake that not only eats other snakes but is immune to their venom.

programme.title: Adventure Ocean Quest: Fragile Meditarranean
programme.desc: Many of the Mediterranean's coastal waters around harbour cities like Marseille were polluted mercilessly in the past, and much of the local reef life died. Now there is change in the air: pollution has been reduced and artificial reefs encourage wildlife to return. Frederic will carry out wildlife population surveys here and oceanographer Sandrine Ruiton hopes that his results will be exceptionally accurate, since noiseless freediving is much less invasive than conventional diving methods.

programme.title: Inhabit: A permaculture Perspective
programme.desc: Inhabit: A Permaculture Perspective explores the many environmental issues facing us today and examines solutions that are being applied using the ecological design process called "permaculture"; a design method and philosophy of life with great potential for solving issues related to agriculture, economics and governance. 'Inhabit' provides an intimate look at permaculture peoples and practices ranging from rural, suburban and urban landscapes. This beautifully made documentary presents a vast array of projects, concepts and translates the diversity of permaculture into something that can be understood by an equally diverse audience. For those familiar, it will be a call to action and a glimpse into what's possible. For those unfamiliar, it will be an introduction to a new way of being and a new way of relating to the Earth. For everyone, it will be a reminder that humans are capable of being planetary healing forces. Audience Favorite Princeton Environmental Film Festival 2015. Audience Choice Award EFFY Environmental Film Festival Yale 2015. Official Selections 2015: Food + Farm Film Fest SF, G2 Green Earth Film Festival, FICMA, Life Sciences Film Festival Prague, American Conservation Film Festival, Finger Lakes Environmental Film Festival, ITSA Back to Nature Film Festival & Crossroads Festival for Documentary Film and Discourse.

programme.title: Expedition Wallacea
programme.desc: In 1850, Alfred Russell Wallace investigates the island world of the malayan archipelagos -- and discovers that the nature there is separated into two parts through a mysterious magical border. A border which still bears his name: The 'Wallace-Line.' 150 years later, a new generation of investigators travel to the mysteries Wallace-Line to investigate under water. They dive down to a mystical world, a world in which Wallace was never able to get into. The investors want to find out if a 'marine' Wallace-Line exists.

programme.title: Strange Creatures of the Batangas Sea
programme.desc: Hidden in the magical underwater world of one of the most biodiverse marine areas on the planet exists a community of spectacular animals more peculiar than we can imagine.

programme.title: China's Swan Lake
programme.desc: The largest single concentration of Whooper swans in China is on a newly – and unintentionally -- created wetland. It's a remarkable place, in the heart of central China, just 130 miles as the crow flies from the terracotta warriors' home in Xi'an.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: There are areas around the world where planes, ships, and people seem to vanish without a trace. These zones have been blamed for mysterious phenomena for decades. Each place has an enigmatic and haunting story that has inspired geologists, engineers and archaeologists to study the science behind the myth.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Some animals simply take your breath away. Majestic in so many ways, they move with grace and attack with style. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we meet three majestic animals.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: The marine world is home to an eclectic mix of creatures each with their own unique survival skills, voracious hunting tactics and fascinating adaptations. We begin with the barracuda.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore how different animal species react to impending death. We explore the factors that lead animals to their final resting places: disease, injury, predation, drought, famine. Some species, such as the naked mole rat, while not immortal, seem to be able to effectively protect themselves from certain diseases such as cancer. This raises questions about what is no doubt a sensitive subject, one that brings to mind our own mortality as we speculate about the reasons for this kind of resilience in our animal counterparts. What lessons can we learn from the animal kingdom? We follow individuals to their last breath ... not as voyeurs, but as spectators attuned to the circle of life.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Express
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain Express propels audiences on a steam train journey through the breathtaking vistas of the Canadian Rockies and relates the epic adventure of building the nation's first transcontinental railway.

programme.title: Plastic: The Real Sea Monster
programme.desc: Plastic floats. This is where our story begins. Millions of tonnes of plastic enter the ocean every year, from rivers and shores, ships, and platforms. The world's scientists have studied the phenomenon and come to alarming conclusions.

programme.title: Swimming with Legends
programme.desc: Shot over 2 years and in 9 different destinations, Swimming with Legends documents the life of a Belgium freediver Fred Buyle and his lasting fascination for the legends of the deep as described in ancient texts and mariner's nightmares.

programme.title: Predator's Playground
programme.desc: This African spring is a lifeline and a trap. Flowing from a sandy riverbed 30 km from the Zambezi, it draws animals from August to November. But cliffs turn it into an ambush zone for lion prides, who strike with deadly precision, taking prey from buffalo to baby elephants. It’s a predator’s playground.

programme.title: Ocean Odyssey
programme.desc: 500 million years ago life left this blue womb and colonized the land, but we are still intricately linked to the ocean. Our climates, coastlines, ecosystems, and economies are tied to the perpetual movement of water between continents. The great ocean currents are the arteries and veins of Planet Earth! This is the story of one particularly fascinating flow – the East Australian Current, a massive oceanic river that stretches the length of Australia's east coast.

programme.title: World’s Wildest City: Manaus
programme.desc: Manaus is crawling with reptiles and the cold blooded creatures often get themselves into trouble. Snakes are found in bedrooms, tortoise by roads. Wherever they are, the city’s reptile specialists are on hand to help them out.

programme.title: World’s Wildest City: Manaus
programme.desc: This time we look at the most unusual animals in Manaus, creatures that can only be described as weird and wonderful. Unusual rodents, exotic birds and one of the weirdest monkeys on the planet, the white faced saki, live in the metropolis. And these species are finding strange ways to adapt to city life.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Nigel comes face-to-face with the Philippine cobra, the most lethally venomous cobra on the planet. And in deep, dark caves on Palawan Island, the presenter searches for giant reticulated pythons sheltering from the heat of the day.

programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Express
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain Express propels audiences on a steam train journey through the breathtaking vistas of the Canadian Rockies and relates the epic adventure of building the nation's first transcontinental railway.

programme.title: Plastic: The Real Sea Monster
programme.desc: Plastic floats. This is where our story begins. Millions of tonnes of plastic enter the ocean every year, from rivers and shores, ships, and platforms. The world's scientists have studied the phenomenon and come to alarming conclusions.

programme.title: Swimming with Legends
programme.desc: Shot over 2 years and in 9 different destinations, Swimming with Legends documents the life of a Belgium freediver Fred Buyle and his lasting fascination for the legends of the deep as described in ancient texts and mariner's nightmares.

programme.title: Predator's Playground
programme.desc: This African spring is a lifeline and a trap. Flowing from a sandy riverbed 30 km from the Zambezi, it draws animals from August to November. But cliffs turn it into an ambush zone for lion prides, who strike with deadly precision, taking prey from buffalo to baby elephants. It’s a predator’s playground.

programme.title: Ocean Odyssey
programme.desc: 500 million years ago life left this blue womb and colonized the land, but we are still intricately linked to the ocean. Our climates, coastlines, ecosystems, and economies are tied to the perpetual movement of water between continents. The great ocean currents are the arteries and veins of Planet Earth! This is the story of one particularly fascinating flow – the East Australian Current, a massive oceanic river that stretches the length of Australia's east coast.

programme.title: Sharks (3DE) - (IMAX film)
programme.desc: Presented by Jean-Michel Cousteau, Sharks 3D is a breathtaking new three-dimensional film experience that offers audiences an astonishing up-close encounter with the Lions and Tigers of the Ocean.

programme.title: Search for the Great Sharks
programme.desc: From the coast of California to the remote reaches of South and Western Australia, this film pursues blue sharks, whale sharks, and the notorious great white to allow viewers an up-close experience.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: On the trail of his top ten, Nigel meets worshippers and vipers at Penang's famous Snake Temple and meets a new squeeze, a snappy reticulated python over 4 metres long! In hilltop forests there's a red-headed krait and the David Bowie spider. He joins fishermen to net some superb sea snakes. But which of Malaysia's 40 venomous snakes will make the top spot?

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Australia's renowned deadly serpents include the inland taipan, the most toxic serpent in the world, and the enormous king brown, which can deliver more venom in a single bite than any other snake. As Nigel counts down his top ten, he's helped by Steve Irwin's son Robert, whose favourite billabong is a prime spot for a snake on Nigel's list.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Every year over a million people are bitten by snakes, resulting in some 46,000 deaths - Nigel tracks down the ten deadliest. He meets an enormous king cobra and the infamous Russell's viper, a snake responsible for more deaths than any other. With the help of the Irula, a tribe of snake hunters, he faces off with kraits, vipers and cobras.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Europe is home to some 50 species of snakes; around 19 of them are venomous. Nigel crosses the continent in search of the most dangerous. On the Greek island of Milos there's an endangered viper that ambushes birds, while in Spain there are Montpellier snakes, asp vipers, colourful lizards and egg-laden toads. Amid ancient Turkish ruins he uncovers a massive Ottoman viper, a snake once used as a weapon of war.

programme.title: Secret Seychelles: D’Arros
programme.desc: D'Arros is one of the Seychelles' best kept secrets. Safe-guarded by isolation, the island is a jewel of the Indian Ocean. Teaming with wildlife, the sand cay and neighbouring coral atoll are home to rare giant tortoises, hawksbill turtles, and shearwaters. In the depths, dolphins, greater hammerhead and tiger sharks roam. Green turtles nest on the pristine beaches, reef sharks bear live pups in the shallow lagoon, whales come to the deep channel, and mantas feed over coral reefs. Now designated as a wildlife reserve this natural treasure trove has the recognition it so rightly deserves.

programme.title: Adventure Ocean Quest: Shark Paradise of Polynesia
programme.desc: French Polynesia's great hammerhead sharks are extraordinarily shy animals and still pose many questions, not least where they go during their annual migration. Freediver Frederic Buyle and cameraman Christian Petron team up with scientist Dr. Johan Mourir to investigate these bizarre predators.

programme.title: Sharks: The Big Five
programme.desc: The ocean has its own Big Five. Featuring great whites, to hammerheads, tigers, bulls, and the intimidating whale shark, this is the ultimate shark show. Delve deep into the African waters and discover a new side of these prehistoric predators of the sea, while reconsidering the Hollywood portrayal which has done much to damage the reputation of these gentle creatures.

programme.title: Giants of Fortune - The Whale Sharks of Oslob
programme.desc: In the little Filipino village of Oslob on the Cebu Island, people suffer from typhoons and overfishing. Until the world's biggest fish and the Internet change everything.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

For Spiro, the city’s heritage as the birthplace of jazz is reflected in its mélange of arts and food culture that always feels fresh, inviting, and joyous, even after a lifetime of visits. “There’s this ‘all senses on overload’ side to New Orleans that takes my breath away every time.”

programme.title: America's Musical Journey
programme.desc: A cross-country adventure through the musical heritage of America and the cultural cities where America's music was born.

programme.title: American Beats
programme.desc: The Twin Cities, Minneapolis and St. Paul, while distinct in character, share a deep appreciation for music and cultural diversity. Chunz and Makh set out to discover the sounds and messages of unity emerging in the African community with traditional performer Christian Adeti and dive into a new genre of Somali rap with rapper DJ Fawzi. With it’s vibrant modern culture and rich musical history, The Twin Cities are a special destination you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: American Beats
programme.desc: Known as the quintessential party music, Polka is alive and evolving in the great city of Milwaukee. At the beloved festival of Germanfest, Polka Hall of Fame legend Peggy Mueller showcases her traditional roots while The November Criminals share their fusion of polka and hip-hop, making it clear there is something for everyone. From buttonboxes to beers and brats, this is a city full of personality and a deep love for its musical heritage.

programme.title: American Beats
programme.desc: Kansas City, Missouri, is an integral part of jazz history in America. Shaped by legends who once graced its streets, it is bursting with deep history, mouth-watering cuisine and a lively jazz scene. World-renowned trumpeter, tap dancer, and entertainer, Lonnie McFadden and celebrated singer and tap dancer Chloe McFadden, show Chunz and Makh what it’s all about. From finger-licking barbecue to sports events and a bustling nightlife, this city is a cultural hub offering endless opportunities for a fun-filled getaway.

programme.title: Cheat Meal

programme.title: Cheat Meal
programme.desc: Tyler and Monica dive back into Virginia Beach's vibrant food scene to build the ultimate cheat meal for George Culver, the food-loving force behind the popular @iheartfoodvb. From the tropical vibes at Moxy Virginia Beach to the game-filled hangouts at Beachside Social, and the delightful flavors of Oh Mochi, De Rican Chef, and Belvedere South, they pull out all the stops to craft a meal that’s as unforgettable as it is indulgent!

programme.title: Cheat Meal
programme.desc: Tyler and Monica head to Galveston, Texas, to create a fiery feast for Concetta, the spice-obsessed owner of Maceo Spice & Import Co. From the coastal vibes at Vida Agave to island-famous eats at The Spot, savory classics at Mario’s Seawall, local favorites at Mosquito Cafe, and indulgent sweets from Pattycakes Bakery, they turn up the heat to craft a cheat meal packed with bold flavors and Galveston flair.

programme.title: Dropped S4
programme.desc: Als Chris en Kaid dagenland in de tent vastzitten, breekt het weer eindelijk door. Ze realiseren zich dat de rivier door de regen gevaarlijk overstroomd is. Desondanks gaat de jacht op groot wild door.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S2
programme.desc: Vlak voor de kust van Afrika ligt een strook van 115 eilanden die de Seychellen worden genoemd. Het gebied was oorspronkelijk geclaimd door Frankrijk in de jaren 1700, en nog steeds is de Franse aanwezigheid merkbaar in de keuken en bij de Frans-sprekende bevolking.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S2
programme.desc: Wanneer twee oceanen met elkaar in botsing komen, ligt er chaos in het verschiet. In deze aflevering waagt Mario zich voor de kust van Kaapstad, waar de Indische Oceaan en de Atlantische Oceaan samenkomen.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S2
programme.desc: Diep in de wildernis van Noord-Zuid-Afrika is stroperij aan de orde van de dag, en de wildernis is daarom extreem gevaarlijk. Mario probeert de eerste persoon in het gebied te worden die ooit een van de gevaarlijkste dieren in Afrika heeft gevangen.

programme.title: Wardens S5
programme.desc: Vier juli in Montana – Flathead Lake is dé plek voor feest. Maar met de hitte lopen de spanningen op, en overmatig alcoholgebruik zorgt voor gevaarlijke situaties.

programme.title: Wardens S5
programme.desc: Wanneer de natuurgebieden worden opengesteld voor het verzamelen van afgeworpen geweien, staan alle Montana Wardens paraat. Meldingen van beren, poema’s en verdwaalde jagers houden hen constant bezig.

programme.title: Wardens S5
programme.desc: Jetski’s die te dicht bij boten komen? Dat kan gevaarlijk worden. En Warden Bryan Golie ondervraagt een visser in zijn zoektocht naar de waarheid.

programme.title: Survival Science S1
programme.desc: Laura en Nick reizen naar een ultramodern blikseminslag-laboratorium. Met enkele "explosieve" experimenten bepalen ze de kracht van de bliksem en hoe deze zich gedraagt. Ze ontdekken ook hoe jagers en vissers zich het beste er tegen kunnen beschermen.

programme.title: Survival Science S1
programme.desc: Nick en Laura ervaren de razernij van de natuur op een plek waar verschrikkelijke orkanen, ijskoude winden en zelfs tornado's gesimuleerd kunnen worden. Voor deze experimenten gebruiken ze indrukwekkende apparatuur die enorme stormen creëert op Hollywood-sets.

programme.title: Survival Science S1
programme.desc: Laura en Nick onderzoeken de technieken om de gevaarlijkste roofdieren tegen te kunnen houden. We zullen het gedrag, de kracht, het gezichtsvermogen en de snelheid van bergleeuwen wetenschappelijk analyseren door middel van extreme experimenten, zowel overdag en in de nacht.

programme.title: The Hunt for Monster Bass S1
programme.desc: Ott DeFoe vist in wateren waar al tientallen jaren niemand heeft gevist, op zoek naar de ultieme largemouth bass.

programme.title: The Hunt for Monster Bass S1
programme.desc: Tel het seizoen af terwijl we toewerken naar de onthulling van de echte Monster Largemouth Bass.

programme.desc: Na een succesvolle jacht verdwijnt Adrian Knopp's jachtpartner, Garrett Hagen, nadat hij de gestroopte beer naar hun bootje bracht. Maar nu zit Adrian zelf vast op een vlakte, omringd door beren en wolvenroedels. Er is ook nog een enorme storm op komst. Hoe kan hij dit overleven?

programme.title: Fight to Survive S2

programme.title: Fight to Survive S2

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17

programme.desc: Witte haaien zijn een van de gevreesdste roofdieren op aarde en toch weten we maar heel weinig over ze. De wetenschap heeft via de evolutiebiologie de geheimen van dit perfecte roofdier aan het licht gebracht.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1
programme.desc: In de experimenten van deze week maken we wat vuurwerk van aluminiumfolie, brouwen we een stinkend goedje en proberen we een alchemistisch experiment uit: lood in goud veranderen.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1
programme.desc: De experimenten van deze week geven inzicht in de wetenschap achter het maken van een gloeiende augurk, hoe forensische teams DNA isoleren en hoe zuur simpele huishoudelijke voorwerpen kunnen wegsmelten.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1
programme.desc: De experimenten van deze week onderzoeken hoe je geheime boodschappen kunt versturen met hitte, hoe een beetje gesmolten kaarsvet in een bom kan veranderen en waarom hitte een essentieel ingrediënt is bij het koken van een ei.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1
programme.desc: Toen iemand bij Mark Zuckerberg van Facebook voor het eerst de Like-knop opperde, had hij een simpel antwoord: "Nee."

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1
programme.desc: Futuristisch ontwerper Robert Propst, droomde van de 'Action Office' als een werkplekutopie die het onbenutte potentieel van de hedendaagse kenniswerker zou verwezenlijken.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1
programme.desc: Barcodes hebben de wereldhandel radicaal veranderd en de opkomst van gigantische bedrijven als Walmart en wereldmachten als China bevorderd.

programme.title: Rethink S1
programme.desc: We bekijken de kunststroming fotorealisme en dagen je gehoor opnieuw uit met het McGurk-effect. Ga mee terug in de tijd met Pepper’s Ghost en ontmoet vooruitdenker Leonardo da Vinci.

programme.title: Rethink S1
programme.sub-title: Zeno’s paradox and The UV - A Blacklight
programme.desc: We onthullen geheimen uit het goochelaarsvak, bespreken de tegenstrijdigheden van Zeno’s paradox en ontdekken UV-A zwartlicht. Ook bekijken we opnieuw de levitatie-illusie én illusionist David Blaine.

programme.title: Rethink S1
programme.desc: De lichten gaan uit en de schijnwerpers staan op de kunst van het schaduwspel. Daarna verkennen we kaarttrucs, optische illusies en sluiten af met performer en herdenker Félicien Treway.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don’t know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don’t know much – and certainly not nearly enough – about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe.

programme.title: The New Frontier S3
programme.desc: Hoe gaan astronauten om met het dagelijks leven in de ruimte? De bijzondere omgeving, het gebrek aan smaak in hun voedsel en de geur van ingeblikte lucht dragen allemaal bij tot de stress van het leven en werken in de ruimte.

programme.title: The New Frontier S3
programme.desc: Klimaatverandering en vervuiling hebben ernstige gevolgen voor de atmosfeer van onze planeet. In deze aflevering geven we een overzicht van de nieuwste technologie en wetenschap die de kwaliteit van onze lucht onderzoekt.

programme.title: Unearth S1
programme.desc: Een nieuwe vijand is in opkomst. Deze nieuwe vijand is de natuur zelf, een microscopisch rijk van bacteriën. En niet zomaar bacteriën, maar de zogenaamde superbacteriën. We kijken naar opduikende gevaren en wat wetenschappers doen om ze tegen te kunnen gaan.

programme.title: Unearth S1
programme.desc: Om klimaatverandering tegen te gaan, moeten we alle middelen gebruiken die we hebben, waaronder dus kernenergie. Deze aflevering gaat over de nieuwe, veiligere kerntechnologie en hoe die gebruikt zou kunnen worden in een land als Australië dat steenkool verbrandt.

programme.title: Unearth S1
programme.desc: We kijken samen met wetenschappers naar een recente ontdekking, namelijk de oudst overgebleven zoogdierstaart gevangen in barnsteen.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4
programme.desc: Terry en Larry testen 3 scènes uit de Equalizer films van Denzel Washington. Kan Terry net zo stoer zijn als Denzel en propaantanks en een magnetron gebruiken om een explosie te veroorzaken, een nietpistool gebruiken om de slechterik uit de weg te ruimen of een scenario creëren waarin met een grote flits een kamer vol bakbloem kan ontploffen?
